question: Who among the following leaders from INC attended the Second Round Table Conference?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi:-**

 
 
• Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement against British colonial rule.
 
• He is celebrated for his philosophy of nonviolent resistance, which he called "Satyagraha," and his tireless efforts to achieve social and political change through peaceful means.
 
• **He attended the Second Round Table Conference.**
 
 
 
• **Second Round Table Conference:-**
 
 
• It was held in **London **from **September to December 1931.**
 
• The conference was convened by the **British government** to discuss** constitutional reforms** in India.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi attended the conference as the** sole representative** of the **Indian National Congress **(INC).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose:-**

 
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was not present at the Second Round Table Conference, which took place in 1931.
 
• He had been critical of the Congress's approach to negotiations with the British government and had resigned from his position in the Congress Working Committee before the conference.
 
 
 
• **Sucheta Kripalani:-**
 
 
• She​** **was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement, but she **did not attend t**he Second Round Table Conference.
